limitations: Source: World Bank Commodity Price Data (Pink Sheet), October 2026 edition. Part 2 of one two-part factual excerpt, not an independent provider. Across both parts: 71 published series, 134 actual numeric cells and 8 explicitly missing cells for August/September 2026.

Licence: CC BY 4.0 as identified in the dataset-specific World Bank catalogue, https://datacatalog.worldbank.org/search/dataset/0038238/commodity-prices-history-and-projections . Attribution: World Bank; table organization and concise current-basis paraphrases by this authorized Decision OS session. No endorsement implied.

Named upstream providers are preserved exactly from the workbook source cells. No column-specific exception notice was located in the inspected workbook. The World Bank dataset licence does not grant access or reuse rights to independent Bloomberg, Platts, exchange or other upstream services.

Original column labels, units, cell coordinates, display formats and cell values are preserved. Original values are not converted, backfilled, projected, converted from indices or reconstructed from reported changes. Four series are missing in both months: barley, sorghum, Mexican shrimp and tobacco import unit value.

This is a raw statistical dataset for the existing read-source consumer. It is deliberately not the generic 16-column industry observation shape: several market instruments, delivery tenors, current geography and tax treatment are unproven, so they are not manufactured to obtain automatic price changes.

Fields beginning curated_ and curation_caveats are the assistant's interpretation of the current source definitions, not official instrument codes or reader-contract enums. Historical definitions are not silently promoted across replacement dates; current observations are two months in one acquired revision, not independently preserved historical vintages.

Iron ore has a material original unit conflict: Monthly Prices BL6 says $/dmtu while the current 62%-grade spot definition describes USD per dry metric ton. Both clues are preserved in the current-specification/curation fields; no conversion, unit correction or automatic comparison is applied.

Australian coal and nearby cocoa/sugar/rubber references involve futures or rolling benchmark composition; contract labels and unknown tenor remain explicit. Other physical FOB/CIF benchmarks are not automatically classified as spot. Japan LNG observations are the publisher's estimates for the latest two months.

LME official semantic context was separately read at https://www.lme.com/market-data/lme-reference-prices/lme-official-price on 2026-10-17: Official Settlement is the cash offer benchmark. Mapping the workbook's abbreviated settlement term to that official concept would be an inference; this raw table preserves its original wording and does not query an LME feed.

Gas index and composite/component prices overlap; 71 statistical columns are not 71 independent commodities or independent upstream price feeds. No issuer exposures, continuous acquisition or adopted investment decisions are claimed.
input.title: World Bank October 2026 Pink Sheet: August and September original monthly cells, part 2
